context:
Treat the red release gate as a contract reconciliation problem. Classify each
failure, fix product defects first, update only stale tests, then rerun the
full gate and complete a route-by-route browser acceptance pass.
description:
The comprehensive post-remediation run still left the Results Explorer
Chromium e2e gate red with 60 passing tests, 6 failures, 10 skipped tests, and
23 unrun tests. Several failures are likely stale assertions, but others map
to real product regressions: missing Matrix receipt/detail links, disabled-row
selection assumptions, mobile density, stale corpus-summary copy, changed sort
semantics, and result-detail column label changes.

This TODO is the final reconciliation gate after the identity/link, trend,
metric/scope, and home/theme TODOs are implemented. It must classify every
failing assertion as either a product bug or a stale test, update tests only
when product intent is documented, and block completion until automated and
browser evidence agree.

anti_patterns.dont: close P0/P1 issues into deferred work without explicit user approval.
leave Chromium e2e red with only manual spot checks.
rely on one route's passing test to close a cross-route contract.
update snapshots or selectors before classifying product behavior.

preserves.behavior: Do not ignore disabled controls, stale labels, or missing links as mere test brittleness without route evidence.
Do not make failing tests less specific without tying them to documented product intent.
Do not mark this gate complete until the browser route matrix and automated tests agree.
Do not use skipped or unrun tests as evidence that behavior is fixed.

prior_art.concept: The dependency TODOs in this worktree define the new identity, trend, metric/scope, and home/theme contracts.
_project/DONE/results-explorer-followup-todo-review/planning/results-explorer-followup-remediation-release-gate.yaml captured the previous release gate structure.
results-explorer/e2e/ contains the failing Chromium e2e gate.
results-explorer/src/pages/__tests__/ and results-explorer/src/components/__tests__/ contain route and component expectations that may be stale.

verifications.expected: all Results Explorer unit/component tests pass
Chromium e2e has zero unexpected failures
logs and audit artifact record the final gate outcome

work_units.summary: Reproduce and classify every current release-gate failure
Route product defects through dependency TODOs before changing tests

work_units.notes:
For failures classified as stale tests, update selectors and assertions to
match the documented contract. Examples:
  - platform sort tests should assert the chosen deterministic order for
    base names versus variant names;
  - result-detail tests should assert `Median latency` if that is the
    accepted label, including units elsewhere;
  - home smoke tests should assert current scope/corpus copy, not removed
    legacy strings;
  - compare selection tests should select the first enabled row or assert
    disabled-state recovery copy.
Decision gate: every test edit must cite the product contract it now
enforces in code comments, helper names, or PR notes.
work_units.summary: Update stale tests to assert documented product contracts
Add missing contract regression tests for new issues

work_units.notes:
Run the same release-gate commands used for the failing review. Capture
command status, counts, and failure tails under
`_project/verification-logs/results-explorer-release-gate-reconciliation-after-contract-fixes/`.
Decision gate: this TODO cannot move to DONE with failing Chromium e2e,
typecheck, build, or targeted unit tests unless the failure is documented as
an external/environment issue with a separate follow-up.
work_units.summary: Run the full Results Explorer release gate

work_units.notes:
Restart the local dev server and manually/browser-automate:
  - Leaderboards filters, sorting, comparison entrypoint, theme, mobile
    density, and scope copy;
  - Benchmarks index and one benchmark detail page across Matrix, Ranks,
    List, chart tabs, benchmark switcher, scale switcher, selection, detail
    links, and receipts;
  - Platforms index and one platform detail page across filters, trend,
    chart tabs, platform switcher, selection, detail links, and receipts;
  - Compare empty builder, share URL, baseline selector, warning links,
    chart tabs, selected cards, and result links;
  - Query Workbench facets, visible columns, SQL disclosure, exports,
    sorting, row detail links, and compare selection;
  - Result detail breadcrumb, compare action, receipt/audit data, metric
    labels, and navigation back to related benchmark/platform pages.
Click every visible button/link/control at least once unless it is external
or destructive. Record remaining defects with root cause, blind spot, and
deeper consideration.
work_units.summary: Perform browser acceptance on every Results Explorer route

work_units.notes:
Write a compact audit artifact at
`_project/audits/results-explorer-release-gate-reconciliation-after-contract-fixes-<date>.md`
containing checked SHA, command summary, e2e counts, browser acceptance
matrix, closed issue mapping, and any remaining P2/P3 follow-ups. Decision
gate: any unresolved P0/P1 defect blocks completion and must become a new
TODO or reopen the relevant dependency TODO.
